facts.fact: Benin's media regulator HAAC, in decision N°25-083 of 9 December 2025 for the 11 January 2026 elections, formally bans manipulating statements or information through uncontrolled and irresponsible AI use, with sanctions up to suspension from the campaign for non-compliant outlets.

BEN.note: No dated enforcement under the decision is stated.
Nothing on government use of AI.
No AI built in the country stated.
Campaign media rules only; no named criticism of a policy, cut or punishment stated.
